{"code": "df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count number of duplicate patient_ids
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)  # 48 unique patient IDs that appear more than once

# Number of rows for these duplicate patients
n_duplicate_rows = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicate_patients.index)].shape[0]  # 96 rows

# Number of re-tested patients: each re-tested patient contributes 2 rows
n_retested_patients = n_duplicate_rows // 2  # 48 rows → 24 patients

# Now deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Output
n_patients, n_duplicate_rows, n_retested_patients"}
